prompt: A trace shows the checkout spent 2 seconds waiting on the tax service.
why: Traces show where time goes across services. That's observability.
trap: No alert fired; this is investigating.

prompt: Logs are JSON with request_id, so all lines for one request can be found together.
why: Structured, correlated logs are part of observability.
trap: It isn't config; it's how you see what happened.

prompt: Instead of a fixed dashboard, engineers can slice latency by customer, region and version to find the cause.
tells: slice latency by customer, region and version
why: Asking new questions of your data is what observability means.
trap: Alerts tell you something's wrong; this finds why.

prompt: A dashboard shows request rate, errors and latency for each service.
why: Metrics are one of the three signals.

prompt: The outage took hours to explain because nothing recorded what the queue workers were doing.
tells: nothing recorded what the queue workers were doing
why: Missing logs and metrics make problems hard to explain.
trap: Rollback restores service; observability explains it.

prompt: Each service adds its own span to the request, passing a trace ID in the headers.
tells: passing a trace ID in the headers
why: Propagating trace IDs is distributed tracing.
trap: Headers carry it, but it's observability.
